long_biography.plain_text:
Naviera Fos and a Valencia towage company established by his paternal grandfather formed the family platform inherited by Vicente Boluda Fos. After taking control in 1982, he set out to internationalise and diversify the operation, converting it into Boluda Corporación Marítima and organising activity around towage, shipping and port logistics.

Expansion continued through new markets and acquisitions, including Kotug Smit Towage and Smit Lamnalco. Those transactions extended the tug network across Europe, Africa, Asia and other regions. Boluda remains executive chairman and sole shareholder, while current divisional executives oversee towage and shipping within the group he controls.
